attendee.subject_b: Q Hamirani on AI's core HR metric: 'Do more with less'
attendee.preheader: Key takeaways on scaling AI in HR from our live session.
attendee.body_md:
Hi {{firstname}},

Thank you for joining us live for "From Hype to High-Impact: How to Start and Scale AI in HR." It was a valuable discussion on what it really takes to start, scale, and govern AI in HR across the employee lifecycle.

**{{takeaway_headline}}** {{takeaway_body}}

Here are a few key takeaways from the session:

*   Hypergrowth necessitates a scalable HRIS for global operations. [01:17]
*   AI's core HR metric: doing more with less. [04:47]
*   AI in HR requires cautious experimentation and controlled environments. [12:05]

As Q Hamirani shared, "Yeah, so I think like a lot of us even I think in the in the poll kind of reflected. I think we are all in various journeys of AI within different processes in the HR space as well. So there isn't one single metric, well if there is one single metric I would say, it's can we do more with less, right?" [04:47]

Watch the full recording here: [Session Recording]({{recording_link}})

Ready to explore how AI can transform your HR operations? [Learn More]({{cta_link}})

The Darwinbox Team
